comments.text: Is the DRC Communist? During the Vietnam War Communist North Vietnam was officially the Democratic Republic of Vietnam while free South Vietnam was simply the Republic of Vietnam. Similarly, Communist East Germany was officially the German Democratic Republic while free West Germany was the Federal Republic of Germany.
